data.name: Jamshid
data.gender_notes: Jamshid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jamshid is a unisex name of Arabic and Persian origin, meaning 'Glory of the Sun'. The name Jamshid carries the meaning “Glory of the Sun” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jamshid usually hope their child will grow to embody glory of the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamshid total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Jamshid
in_english.long_meaning: Jamshid is an ancient Persian name referring to a pre-Islamic king, mentioned in the Quran, and holds significant importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing power and wisdom, and is still used in many Muslim cultures today

data.cultural_impact: In Iranian mythology, Jamshid was believed to be a savant king, the "King of the Age of Gold", who brought people prosperity and wealth. His reign was considered the golden age of ancient Iran.
data.spiritual_significance: In Zoroastrianism, Jamshid was the priest-king who communicated directly with the gods on behalf of the people, making him a bridge between the divine and the human world. He was also revered as the patron of agriculture, food, and fire, symbolizing the abundant nourishment and warmth of life.
